name: Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma

criteria.description: Presence of malignant epithelial cells with clear cytoplasm and distinct cell borders on histopathology
Contrast-enhanced CT or MRI showing a solid renal mass with heterogeneous enhancement
Positive staining for CAIX (carbonic anhydrase IX) and PAX8 on tumor tissue
Detection of VHL gene mutation or 3p chromosome deletion

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of clear cell morphology with supportive imaging findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing and immunohistochemistry aid in confirmation but are not mandatory.

pathognomonic.notes: Visible blood in urine, often intermittent

pathognomonic.symptomName: Palpable abdominal mass in flank region

common.symptomName: Flank pain localized to affected kidney

occasional.symptomName: Polycythemia due to ectopic erythropoietin production
occasional.notes: Leads to increased red blood cell mass

excess red blood cells due to hormone production
increased red blood cells from ectopic erythropoietin

occasional.notes: Due to tumor invasion of left renal vein
searchTerms: enlarged veins in scrotum, especially left side
swollen scrotal veins on one side
low red blood cells from chronic illness
chronic disease causing low blood count

rare.notes: Due to PTHrP secretion by tumor

searchTerms: brain or nerve deficits from tumor spread

rare.notes: Rare skin nodules from tumor spread

laboratory: Elevated serum calcium levels in paraneoplastic hypercalcemia
imaging: Contrast-enhanced CT showing hypervascular renal mass with areas of necrosis
MRI demonstrating heterogeneous renal tumor with clear cell features
other: Positive immunohistochemical staining for CAIX and PAX8
Histopathology showing clear cytoplasm and delicate vasculature

distinguishingFeatures: Pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear halos
Better prognosis than clear cell RCC

redFlags: Unexplained weight loss with flank mass
New onset hypertension with renal mass
